about: Things to test on this beta. Tick each one off. If something is wrong, tap Report a problem on it.

checks.text: Send to several contacts: each shows Delivered within seconds when their phone is awake.
A phone that is locked or asleep shows Waiting. Tap Waiting: it says whose phone, and why.
Turn on airplane mode, send, wait 30 seconds: the calm delayed line shows. Back online, it goes by itself.
A long message uses the whole bubble, with the time under it when it does not fit beside the last line.
Set text to 200%: nothing is cut off or squeezed.
15 minute cellular phone to Kids' TV video call: sound both ways all the way through.
Cast and press the Assistant button mid-call on the TV: the call stays, and so does the sound.
Hang up and call back within 5 seconds.
Labs, Voice over two paths on: a call has sound both ways.
From cellular, send a video in the Family group: it arrives for everyone by itself at full quality.
A long video to a trusted contact: no shrink question, no length limit.
Turn off the receiver mid-way, turn it back on: it goes on from where it stopped.
Settings, Files: no Send media choice any more. Tor shows on a file's card only with Ultra privacy on.
A file from someone not trusted still shows the Accept card.
Read a message aloud: one voice, Female, reads the words clearly. A phone or PC that had Male frees its space.
Labs, Voice tuning: presets A, B and E sound clearly different.
On the Kids' Device page, Release: Stable or Pre-release. Stable is the start. The device follows what the parent picks.
Saved media Send bar sits above the navigation bar on a Pixel 10.
Landscape with 3-button navigation: nothing sits under the bar or the camera cutout.
A video of 1 to 3 minutes to a Family member pops up in their chat by itself and plays when tapped.
In a video call, Share video: pick a video. It plays large on the other phone or the Kids' TV, with its sound under your voices. Pause, Play and Stop work.
Kids' TV in a call: press Home. The call screen comes right back and the call goes on.
A video call on a weak connection: the picture gets smaller instead of freezing, and sharpens again when the connection recovers.
Labs mode: hold the raven at the top for 7 seconds. It buzzes and opens Report a bug with the screenshot and the activity log.
Huginn: Settings, Accessibility, Dictation on: it downloads once. Then the microphone in the message box turns speech into text.
